items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: They got Milton Hinton on the bass, and they got Danny on the guitar.

ctx.x: Well, that was the best job in town. That band pay more money than any band, even Duke. So I took the job.

So I stay with Cab. Cab (inaudible) a band to compete with those big jazz bands. He just wanted to be a showman. I got the best because I can pay the better, have the better. So they had Cozy Cole. So they had Chu Berry. They got Milton Hinton on the bass, and they got Danny on the guitar.
